content: cert-manager v1.20.3 (Jun 2026) with Let's Encrypt DNS-01 via Cloudflare API token is standard for internal-only homelab services: valid certs without public exposure, wildcard support. Configure dns01RecursiveNameservers=1.1.1.1:53,1.0.0.1:53 to avoid split-DNS propagation check failures. Scoped API token (Zone:Read, DNS:Edit) preferred over global key.
